intro.text: Lord Bastien Severington, mayor of Bilming in 342 PC.

items.text: Invited by Lady Kelesina Shores to speak at her party in New Seran, Severington denounced Elendel's "tyranny" and unfair taxes, even likening its rule to the Lord Ruler's. Amplified, the speech carried to Wax in another room, and he realized Bilming had the weight to lead anti-Elendel feeling toward civil war.
